description: Help to generate fields (with StructuresFieldAttribute) for plugin data, fields for plugin, and properties (with StructuresDialogAttribute) for view model which used by plugin WPF UI.
releaseNotes:
Includes all beta updates and some improvements：

Improvements:
Adjust the way to collect diagnostic information.
The default value of BoltDistX and BoltDistY has been changed from "" to "0.0".
            
2.0.0-beta.4
Automatically generates specific content based on the Tekla.Structures.Model version.
Currently, for TSM 2023 and later versions, BoltGroup has SlotOffsetX and SlotOffsetY properties, and the HoleType property ranges from 0 to 3;
for TSM versions before 2023, BoltGroup does not have SlotOffsetX and SlotOffsetY properties, and the HoleType property ranges from 0 to 2.

2.0.0-beta.3
1. Add 'CustomPartViewModel' abstract class;
2. Add support for the 'Chamfer' fields and properties;
3. Complete the missing modification to the 'Preparation' property in the 'CreatWeld**' method and the 'ModifyToWeld**' method;

2.0.0-beta.1
Destructive update:
1. '**PropertiesWithDefaultValuesAttribute' was renamed and replaced the old '**PropertiesAttribute' (the original name was too long and inconvenient to use).
Feature improvement update:
1. Added some 'Creat**' methods which only need to pass in generic parameter to automatically use the associated fields to create model object.
2. Added some 'ModifyTo**' methods which only need to pass in existing object to automatically use the associated fields to modify it.
3. In previous versions, the code for analysis to collect information needed for generation and the code for diagnostics had many similarities, now the two have been integrated together.
4. Supports using attributes by specifying property equal to value like 'Property = value'.
5. If at least one '**FieldDefaultValuesAttribute' is used, other fields without specified default value will also be registered use the preset value.
